title: Language models show human-like content effects on reasoning tasks

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (Belief bias and Content effects)
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model and human performance across three logical reasoning tasks (Natural Language Inference, syllogism validity judgments, and the Wason selection task) by systematically manipulating the semantic content of the problems to either support, violate, or be neutral (nonsense/arbitrary) to real-world prior beliefs and knowledge.

primary_bias_target: Cognitive bias (Belief bias and Content effects)
